target.definition: Total U.S. retail and food services sales for June 2026, seasonally adjusted and adjusted for holiday and trading-day differences but not for price changes, as first reported in the Census Bureau's advance release.

inputs.name: annual_retail_sales_2026
inputs.description: Annual total U.S. retail and food services sales in 2026 nominal dollars, seasonally adjusted concept.

provenance.rationale: Extrapolates recent Census retail and food services sales levels to 2026 nominal dollars.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year, used to convert an annual total to a monthly total.

provenance.rationale: Extrapolates recent U.S. population growth trends.

inputs.name: monthly_retail_spend_per_capita
inputs.description: Average retail and food services spending per person during a month.

provenance.rationale: Implied by recent monthly retail totals divided by U.S. population.

inputs.name: nominal_gdp_2026
inputs.description: U.S. nominal GDP for 2026, annual total.

provenance.rationale: Extrapolates recent nominal GDP levels to 2026.

inputs.name: retail_share_of_gdp
inputs.description: Share of nominal GDP represented by retail and food services sales.

provenance.rationale: Recent retail and food services sales are roughly a quarter to three tenths of nominal GDP.

paths.description: Allocate annual retail and food services sales to a single month.
Multiply U.S. population by average monthly retail spending per person.
Scale nominal GDP by the retail and food services share, then divide into months.
